name: com.tencent.qcloud.tuicore.component.activities.SelectionActivity
description: Tencent Cloud TUI IM Core from the YJJk Video Doctor SDK opens a text-entry or option-list screen when the host app asks someone to edit a value or choose one item. It returns the entered text or selected option to the app.
disableEffect: The app cannot open these text-entry and choice screens, so flows that use them stop at the selection step.
